description: Repère de crue is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Niort. Location of flood markers in the municipality of Niort. The fields correspond to the following data: HAUTREPER: Height of the flood leash NUMLAISSE: Marker ID. Coverage: Ville de Niort. The portal shows the English title as "Flood mark" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Niort. Its keywords include inondation, vdn, geospatial, niort, opendata. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, JSON, KML, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
